boundaries: private template clone and every file/directory sync precede open/timing; fixture generation, clone/sync, Endpoint open, and exact reopened comparison are separate. Instrumentation changes code generation and adds counter/timer overhead: this is attribution only, not a production speed comparison.
ordering: Two complete blocks 0 then 1; population order and four-arm order rotate by block as in the prior helper. All 32 observations retained; no retry or filtering.
timing: local_operation_total.cpu_ns includes preparation, instrumented handlers, profile reset/take and checks, validated Published and request-buffer teardown. Handler cost includes snapshot scan instrumentation; disk_usage clocks are a subset, never summed again. Profile reset and take are outside handler clocks. No per-entry clock, output or allocation is added. Counts are Rust API call sites, not OS syscall counts.
